column1: # Redistribution-notice manifest for the bundled JBIG2 encoder.
# bundle-jbig2enc.ps1 ships ONE binary — jbig2.exe from the official
# jbig2enc 0.32 Windows x64 MSVC release asset. It is a STATIC build: leptonica,
# libtiff, libjpeg-turbo, libpng, zlib-ng, openjpeg, libwebp and giflib are
# linked inside that single executable rather than sitting beside it as DLLs.
# A per-FILE manifest (the tesseract-licenses.tsv shape) would therefore
# account for one row and silently drop eight components, so this manifest is
# per COMPONENT and the `file` column names the binary each is linked into.
# The component list is not hand-written. Upstream ships `depmf.json` in the
# same zip — a dependency manifest with exact versions and SPDX ids — and
# bundle-jbig2enc.ps1 REFUSES to ship when a project named there has no row
# here, or when a row's version disagrees with it. `jbig2.exe --version`
# prints the same set at run time and is the cross-check.
# COLUMNS: file <TAB> component <TAB> version <TAB> spdx <TAB> notice <TAB> source
#   file      exact filename as shipped in resources/jbig2enc/
#   component upstream project, spelled as `depmf.json` spells it
#   version   the version frozen inside the pinned binary
#   spdx      SPDX expression. "AND" = every listed licence's terms apply.
#   notice    filename under resources/jbig2enc/licenses/, except jbig2enc's
#             own, which the zip supplies and which ships at the top level
#   source    upstream the notice text came from
# RULES:
#  - A dependency is never removed to simplify this file. Every component gets
#    a row, whatever its licence. (Nothing here is copyleft, but that is a fact
#    about this artifact, not a criterion — this project is MIT open source
#    with a public repository, so the source column answers "where is the
#    source" for any licence.)
#  - Notices are FETCHED ONCE, from a URL pinned to the component version
#    above, by fetch-jbig2enc-licenses.ps1, reviewed as a git diff, and
#    committed. The build copies them offline. There is no ongoing obligation
#    to track upstream relicensing for a binary that is frozen.
#  - JBIG2 is a patented process. Upstream's own PATENTS note ships beside the
#    binary as PATENTS-jbig2enc.txt; it is not a licence and gets no row.
#  - Keep sorted by component so a diff against a fresh depmf.json reads
#    cleanly.
